excerpt.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
excerpt.en: Crime continues to be a problem on [Root.GetName], and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]的犯罪问题仍然没有得到解决，而现在各种犯罪组织已经在[Root.GetPlanetMoon]扎根落脚。许多地区不是堕落为法外之地，就是彻底沦陷在犯罪组织的掌控之中。
texts.en: Crime continues to be a problem on [Root.GetName], and an extensive criminal underworld has now taken root on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon]. Some areas have descended into lawlessness or been taken over completely by criminal organizations.

texts.zh: 幸运的是，这种环境能给我们源源不断地提供新鲜的实验对象。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]迫不及待地想探索新的研究道路了。
texts.en: Fortunately, such environments provide us with an ample supply of fresh test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] are eager to explore new avenues of research.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的叛乱事件持续蔓延，并出现了对蜂巢意志的公开挑衅。情报显示[Root.GetPlanetMoon]上已经出现了成社区的子个体叛乱，并开始窃取其余子个体的资源来维持他们的叛乱活动。
texts.en: Deviant activity continues to grow on [Root.GetName], in open defiance of the will of the Hive Mind. Entire communities of deviant drones are believed to exist on the [Root.GetPlanetMoon] now, stealing resources from the rest of the hive to support their nefarious activities.

texts.zh: 这些反常子个体会作为实验对象得到重新利用。我们的[GetExperimentalEngineerPlural]或许会在后续的解剖中发现它们腐化的原因。
texts.en: Such deviants will find new purpose as test subjects. Our [GetExperimentalEngineerPlural] will perhaps find the root of their corruption during subsequent dissections.

texts.zh: [Root.GetName]上的腐化度进一步恶化了。反常分子开始公开行动，为所欲为，挑战着核心智能的权威。情报显示对方应该已组成了自主的网络以互相交换信息和能源。
texts.en: The corruption grows deeper on [Root.GetName]. Deviant units now operate in the open according to their own parameters, spurning the commands of the core intelligence. They are believed to have formed their own networks where they exchange information and stolen energy.

label.zh: 他们背叛了蜂巢的意志！
label.en: They have strayed from the Hive Mind!

label.zh: 反常行为有一种可靠的治疗方法。
腐化度即将到达临界水平。
